lhs: Dot of a vector broadcast along original axis 0 with a partner. Both contract original axes [0,1].
rhs: Reduce the partner along axis 0, then Dot the original vector with the reduced partner using retained partner dimension number 1.
conditions: Legal parameter vector [n], broadcast [m,n] on dimension 1, partner [m,n,n], no batch axes; positive extents and strict dot-cost improvement at threshold two; both orientations evaluated.
types: Bounded finite coordinates, exact integer logical values, sums and products.
overlap: Both source directions share the same obsolete partner dimension number and count as one case. Separate from dot/rule06 (reduce a broadcasted product), Dot reverse transfer and Dot/Concat splitting. A correctly renumbered contraction is a witness control only.
